caption:
Six layout rules are measured on the rendered page after every edit.

These rules check single-column order, standard headings, real bullet lists, selectable text, no tables or floats, and body text of at least 9.5pt. This is not a certification against any ATS vendor.

JobRez exports to PDF, Word and plain text. PDF and plain-text export are unlimited and watermark-free on the free plan, while Word (.docx) export is Pro.

Read more at jobrez.com.
